children: On October 21, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it had not regained compliance with the minimum market value of publicly held shares requirement under Rule 5450(b)(2)(C) or the minimum market value of listed securities requirement under Rule 5450(b)(2)(A), and determined to delist its units, ordinary shares and rights. The company will not appeal or transfer its listing; trading is expected to be suspended on October 30, 2026, followed by a Form 25-NSE filing, and the company intends to seek OTC Markets quotation.
